title: Prove sharp dirty-commutator target coefficients at minimum calls
body:
## Summary

Scoped all-n proof: choose the split tree with the least sharp completed-target defect coefficient while retaining the minimum paid leaf count and scratch depth.

```text
factors     coefficient       paid calls      dirty connectors
3           7 -> 5            10 -> 10        2 -> 2
5           17 -> 11          28 -> 28        3 -> 3
63          727 -> 665        4000 -> 4000    6 -> 6
```

The exact optimum is `C_min=3^d+2*sum(weights)`, where `d=floor(log2 n)` and the sum takes the `n-2^d` smallest members of the multiset with weight `2^j` repeated `binomial(d,j)` times. An explicit tree attains it, preserves factor order and restores arbitrary dirty inputs at the ideal endpoint. The all-n conclusion rests on the written proof, with finite corroboration.

Produced by Nick Petalas. Credit Adam Gall / adamgall #2067 for the endpoint-response model, Chafik Boukhalfa #628 for the dirty word and Hanson Sun #1085 for factor-order invariants; the full retained lineage is in the package. Their results are cited rather than replayed as the contribution. No new kappa or selected-frontier change.

## Evidence

Before: #2067 fixes the floor-left/ceiling-right tree. After: a binomial-weight construction is sharp among every full ordered binary tree attaining the minimum paid count `3qn-2q^2`.

Local CPython 3.12.15 checks pass:

- All 6,918 ordered tree shapes through ten factors; 275 minimum-paid trees through 16 factors, both orientations; 550 literal words and 83,122 paid gate occurrences.
- Six noncommuting rational 2-by-2 fixtures and ten rejection/boundary controls. Generated receipts bind all six package files.
- Both registered normal and optimized commands, locally timed at 0.13 and 0.15 seconds; metadata/pins, committed bytes and source-history preflight.
- Direct normal and optimized replay from a read-only Git-free copy with empty PATH.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/minpaid-commutator-error/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/minpaid-commutator-error/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/minpaid-commutator-error
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/minpaid-commutator-error --check-source-history
```

Other hosts may substitute any CPython 3.12 interpreter. Expected markers are `PASS_MINPAID_COMMUTATOR_ERROR`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`.

## Limitations

The claim is confined to binary four-phase commutator trees and bounded additive defects supported at each leaf destination. Every ordered subset product must have norm at most G. Sharpness permits independent defects and is witnessed at G=1; an actual rounded kernel may correlate them. This is a completed-target bound, not a scratch/interior bound or a smaller production precision reserve. Other word grammars and extra-paid-call tradeoffs are excluded.

No physical/native caller, rounded kernel, stock, tape, compiler or analytic admission was run or proved. All five selected framework assumptions remain. Lean, Docker, predecessor scientific suites and the selected full replay are unrun. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Instantiate the five-factor tree in an actual rounded-leaf caller, preserving interior feedback, inverse-preimage and movement charges. Kernel defect bounds and a complete caller remain required.
- Determine the target-error versus paid-call frontier when extra calls are permitted. At four factors, 16 calls give coefficient nine and 22 calls can give seven; a paid budget and scratch/interior constraints must be fixed.

## Related open work

- [#5938](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5938) studies maximum-mass leaf-destination channels at arbitrary cuts of the unchanged balanced dirty word. This PR changes the split tree and minimizes the completed-target defect coefficient at the minimum paid count. The quantities differ; no numerical agreement or disagreement is asserted and no extra computation was run to check that PR.

The account's open PRs created since the advance claim were refreshed after CI. No other PR in that set studies this split-tree target-defect optimization. The original overlap search included a 310-open-PR cache, live checks and targeted main-tree/merged-PR searches; sparse local notes and unpublished work limit novelty coverage. Ali Romman's Discussion #5257 concerns deterministic two-factor rounding correlations under a different contract.

## CI notes

At commit `02c1be4057c18f2b1e81be9429f064b5161fb0e6`, both `plan` and `replay (research/minpaid-commutator-error)` passed in [run 40523579121](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40523579121). The checks were read once after completion. Hosted package replay certifies the registered finite checks; the all-n theorem remains the written scoped proof, without independent human or formal proof-kernel review.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way.

**Blast Radius:** isolated.

Six new package files only; existing code, frozen evidence and selected records are unchanged.
